stem:
Meera keeps a small glass tank at home in Pune. Inside the tank are six guppy fish of one kind, some water plants, snails, sand, and water. A biologist notes down everything in the tank, including the living organisms and the non-living parts, along with how they interact.

What is the best description of everything inside the tank?

options.text: a population, because the guppies are one kind of organism living together
a community, because it contains several kinds of living organisms
an ecosystem, because it includes different living organisms interacting with non-living parts
a habitat, because the tank provides shelter for the fish

teacher.key_rationale: The tank includes multiple kinds of organisms (guppies, plants, snails) plus non-living components (sand, water) and their interactions, which is the definition of an ecosystem. Option A is a trap for students who focus only on the guppies; B is a trap for those who stop at the living components and ignore the abiotic parts; D misuses the term habitat for the whole interacting system.
